risk: Settings writes. The danger is a save path that bypasses a domain writer's side effects or a stale page overwriting a newer value; the spec answers both (existing writers stay authoritative, the generic row save is revision-checked and audited). The catalog touches every settings surface, so the catalog test's field-coverage assertion is the safety net against a silently dropped setting.
